events.title: Insurance premium review
events.summary: Your insurer flagged this week’s incident report and wants a safety surcharge.
events.body: Pay the surcharge, or commit to a documented safety program (patrol staffing and first aid coverage).

choices.label: Commit to the safety program
choices.description: Cheaper, but the paperwork dings morale.

events.title: Ski influencer wants a comp day
events.summary: “PowderPriya” (480k followers) is asking for two comp tickets and a gondola photo op.
events.body: Her last resort feature tripled weekend bookings for a small hill in the next valley. She has… opinions… when she pays full price.

choices.label: Comp the tickets
choices.description: Costs a little revenue, likely draws a crowd tomorrow.

events.title: Worrying vibration on a lift gearbox
events.summary: A lift op reports a grinding note from the drive terminal.
events.body: An emergency inspection costs money and won’t find anything half the time. Ignoring it… usually goes fine.

choices.label: Pay for inspection ($1,800)
choices.description: Peace of mind; the hill notices you take safety seriously.

choices.label: Run it and monitor
choices.description: Saves cash. Roll the dice on a breakdown.

events.title: Food critic booked a table
events.summary: The valley paper’s food writer reserved lunch at your restaurant tomorrow.
events.body: A glowing column would put your kitchen on the map.

choices.label: Run a special menu ($600)
choices.description: Impress the critic, charm the room.
